leads.title: Job's piety, the heavenly council and the first test ↔ The night: the giver and the miser

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/08-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: The righteous give and feed solely for the face of God, seeking no repayment or thanks (weight 6.3). Pair score 6.3.
